limitations: The picture blit function-pointer address is a synthetic six-argument host slot (fd_50F6_37EA role), not proof that same-address f_0250_0721 body was invoked. Host pixel transfer/blit is modeled; no physical display/framebuffer equivalence.

winprintf_diagnostic: WinPrintf is excluded as a semantic contract: DOS root:277D:000A is an empty one-byte RETF debug sink. Callsite varargs vary; render_small captures a fixed/truncated stack prefix (the DrawBalloons suite uses stack6 and bitmap calls include 7-word and 5-word payloads), so report helper traces are diagnostic and are not treated as complete variadic arguments, return semantics, or drawing effects. The original sink body has no state effects; this exclusion does not remove bitmap resource/pixel/geometry effects from the target contract.
